sloka: केचिद्विनिहताः कृत्ताश्चेष्टन्ति स्म महीतले ।वाहनेष्ववसक्ताश्च स्थिता एवापरे रणे ।। ७.२८.३९ ॥
transliteration: kecidvinihatāḥ kṛttāśceṣṭanti sma mahītale ।vāhaneṣvavasaktāśca sthitā evāpare raṇe ।। 7.28.39 ॥

translations.english: Some were killed and cut down, writhing on the ground, while others remained stuck on their vehicles in the battle.
